# Mytrya

> Mytrya is a one-person AI engineering practice run by Suraj Malla in Kathmandu, Nepal. It builds AI support agents, internal tools and data pipelines for small B2B software and service companies, on fixed-scope, fixed-price projects. Contact: malla.srj@mytrya.com

## Services
- [AI support agents](https://mytrya.com/services/ai-support-agents): agents that work inside Freshdesk, Zendesk or Intercom, answer from documentation, act in billing and tracking systems, escalate when they can't ground an answer.
- [Internal tools and dashboards](https://mytrya.com/services/internal-tools): small tools that compute operational numbers in code and use a model only to name patterns.
- [Data pipelines and workflow automation](https://mytrya.com/services/workflow-automation): measured rate limits, fallbacks, idempotent jobs; code or n8n/Make.

## Work (case studies)
- [Jetta](https://mytrya.com/work/jetta): AI support agent, 13 tools across Freshdesk, FastSpring, monday.com, Slack. Client anonymized.
- [NEPSE Copilot](https://mytrya.com/work/nepse-copilot): Nepal Stock Exchange research tool that grades its own evidence score at 5/10/20 days.
- [Support Intelligence](https://mytrya.com/work/support-intelligence): daily support-desk dashboard, numbers in code, Gemini for clustering.
- [offScript](https://mytrya.com/work/offscript): AI scene partner for actors. Live at https://offscript.mytrya.com
- [Community Signal](https://mytrya.com/work/community-signal): forum-mining and board-summary tools.
